Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Grant Of Patent
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Inauguration Of New Pilot Plant

analysis.summary: Acutaas Chemicals Limited reported a strong start to Q1 FY27 with a revenue of INR329.7 crores, marking a 59.1% year-on-year growth. Management expressed confidence in achieving 25% full-year revenue growth with stable margins. The company successfully completed trial runs for its battery chemicals plant and commenced commercial supply, while the Indichem semiconductor plant construction is expected to be completed by the end of the quarter. Furthermore, the management highlighted strong performance across advanced pharmaceutical intermediates and specialty chemicals segments. Acutaas Chemicals Limited released its investor presentation for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting a 59.1% year-over-year increase in revenue from operations to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.
guidance.quote: To conclude, we have started the new financial year on a strong note and I remain confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of delivering 25% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I'm confident of delivering 25% revenue growth in FY '27.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for our products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to see healthy RFP activity across CDMO and NCE products.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to see healthy RFP activity across our CDMO and NCE products.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for battery chemicals remains exceptionally strong, driven by tight global supply.
demand_outlook.quote: Within Specialty Chemicals, demand for battery chemicals remain exceptionally strong. I'm pleased to share that we have successfully completed the trial run of our battery chemicals plant and started commercial supply. Demand here is unprecedented, driven by tight global supply and we, therefore, expect a rapid ramp-up over the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Memory chip demand will remain strong, driving demand for materials manufactured in BFC and planned at Indichem.
demand_outlook.quote: Our ongoing engagement with customers reinforces our conviction that memory chip demand will remain strong. Which, in turn, will drive demand for the materials we manufacture in BFC, and plan to manufacture at Indichem.

demand_outlook.claim: New product inquiries continue to arrive at a healthy pace while demand for existing products remains robust.
demand_outlook.quote: New product inquiries continue to come in at a healthy pace while demand for existing products remain robust.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY27 stood at INR56 crores, with INR15 crores at the Indichem site and INR41 crores primarily at the ACL site for the battery chemical project, pilot plant, and maintenance.
capex_expansion.quote: Now turning to the capital expenditures. capex for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR56 crores, out of which INR15 crores were at the Indichem site, remaining INR41 crores in ACL site, which is primarily diverted towards the battery chemical project at the Jhaghadia site. And then pilot plant at our Sachin site and maintenance capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capex will be incurred for a new R&D center and land acquisition for further capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned on our previous earnings call, we will incur additional capex for a new R&D center and for the acquisition of land for further capacity expansion, we will update the market once these projects are finalized.

capex_expansion.claim: The second phase of electrolyte capex is currently ongoing and expected to be completed by Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The second phase of capex is currently ongoing and expected to get completed by Q1 FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Pilot plant capex is now expected to be completed by Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: It is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested INR190 crores in South Korea joint venture Indichem Inc during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: We have invested INR190 crores in this JV during the year FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, with gross margin expanding by 466 basis points year-on-year to 57.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, reflecting a 73% increase compared to the same period last year. The gross margin expanded by 466 basis points Y-o-Y to 57.9%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter reached INR113.1 crores, representing more than a twofold increase year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR113.1 crores, which represents more than twofold increase compared to the EBITDA of the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 34.3%, up 973 basis points year-on-year, driven by gross margin expansion and operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin were at 34.3%, up 973 basis points Y-o-Y. EBITDA margin was driven by expansion in gross margin as well as operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% year-on-year, with PAT margins at 22.7%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% Y-o-Y. PAT margins for the quarter were at 22.7%, which show an expansion of 151 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Management is confident in its ability to maintain EBITDA margin at a similar level in the coming year.
margins_costs.quote: We are confident in our ability to maintain EBITDA margin at a similar level in the coming year.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization for the Sachin unit is 83%, Unit 2 at Ankleshwar is 23%, and Unit 3 Jhagadia is 55% for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. For the capacity utilization for the Sachin unit, the capacity is 83%. For Unit 2 at Ankleshwar, it is 23% and at Unit 3 Jhagadia, 55% for the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were at INR198.3 crores as on 31st March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were at INR198.3 crores as on 31st March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The financial year began on a turbulent note driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf.
risks_headwinds.quote: We began the financial year on a turbulent note, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf.

risks_headwinds.claim: The chemical industry is navigating turbulent conditions driven by the ongoing conflict in the Gulf region, which has disrupted supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The chemical industry has once again navigating turbulent conditions driven by the ongoing conflict in the Gulf region, which has disrupted supply chain for key feedstocks and consequently pushed raw material prices higher.

management_commitments.claim: The Indichem semiconductor plant capex is expected to get completed by the end of the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So this plant, we are happy to share that this is getting constructed even before the schedules and expected to get -- capex is expected to get completed by end of this quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from the Indichem plant is expected to come up from next financial year onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe from next financial year onwards, we will have the revenue coming up from that plant.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 capex for the third product of the Electrolyte Additives segment will be completed by the end of Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And as we mentioned earlier also by end of Q2 FY '27, we would be completing our capex.

management_commitments.claim: Employee cost for the current year should typically be around INR150 crores.
management_commitments.quote: We should typically look at around INR150 crores of employee cost for the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from validated CDMO products is expected to kick in from H2 FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And with regulatory approval in place, we are expecting revenue to kick in from H2 FY '27 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets delivering 25% revenue growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: I'm confident of delivering 25% revenue growth in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The second phase of electrolyte capex is expected to get completed by Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The second phase of capex is currently ongoing and expected to get completed by Q1 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Pilot plant capex is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: It is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: By FY28, both battery chemicals and semiconductors are expected to evolve into independent self-sustaining growth engines.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, I believe that by FY '28, our both business verticals, which are in investment phase now, battery chemicals and semiconductors will evolved into independent self-sustaining growth engines.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
